args.body: Hi Dora! I visited your personal website at www.dora-website.com. It is a clean and friendly introduction, and having your email on the page makes it easy for visitors to reach you. That said, the site feels a little sparse. I would love to see more about you, such as your projects, work or studies, skills(), a short bio, and a few photos to give visitors a better sense of who you are. Adding links to your other profiles like LinkedIn, GitHub(), or your portfolio would also make it more useful. Overall, a nice starting point with plenty of room to grow!

Hi Eve! I visited your blog at www.eve-blog.com and I really like what it feels like — a personal space built around your love of hiking. It is a great theme and it makes the blog feel genuine and inviting. A few ideas if you want to grow it: share recent hikes with photos, trail maps, or short route write-ups, add tags or categories so readers can find posts about specific trails or parks, and include a short about me section and links to your social profiles. Adding a few tips on gear or trip planning could also be very helpful for fellow hikers. Overall, a lovely blog with a clear personal touch — keep it up!
